briefTitle: A Study to Investigate Safety of AZD6750 in Adult Participants With Select Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors

typedChecks.sourceText: Participants with Stage IV NSCLC Dose Escalation/Backfills
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Participants with Stage IV NSCLC Dose Escalation/Backfills

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Provision of 'archival' tumor specimen
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or ability to provide a tissue sample is a procedural requirement.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: At least one measurable lesion according to RECIST v1.1,
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Minimum life expectancy of 12 weeks
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate and stable cardiac function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General adequate and stable cardiac function without specific numeric thresholds is subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate bone marrow, liver and kidney function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General adequate organ function without specific lab cutoffs is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Body weight ≥ 35 kg
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Weight threshold is not among the allowed typed kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Capable of giving signed informed consent
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Informed consent capability is a standard administrative requirement.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with locally advanced or metastatic select solid tumors ... who have received adequate SoC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Adequate standard of care is a general trial context rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have received at least one prior regimen in metastatic setting (2L+ NSCLC). Participants with actionable tumor alterations should have received targeted therapy if locally available OR
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex conditional prior therapy rules and conditional targeted therapy recommendations cannot be expressed with a simple prior_lines_min check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any evidence of: Severe or uncontrolled systemic diseases including respiratory, cardiac or tumor-related conditions
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General severe or uncontrolled systemic diseases are investigator-judged exclusions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History or planned organ or allogeneic stem cell transplantation.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Transplantation history is not among the allowed typed exclusions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active or prior documented autoimmune or inflammatory disorders, within the past 3 years
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Autoimmune disorder history is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any prior toxicities that led to permanent discontinuation of prior immunotherapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior immunotherapy toxicity leading to discontinuation is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Persistent toxicities (CTCAE Grade ≥ 2) caused by previous anti-cancer therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Persistent general toxicities are not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Acute untreated or symptomatic malignant spinal cord compression, or a history of leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Spinal cord compression and leptomeningeal disease are not part of the standard typed brain_mets checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active uncontrolled or chronic infection of hepatitis B, hepatitis C
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Infection status is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior history of Grade ≥ 3 non-infectious pneumonitis.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pneumonitis history is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant requires chronic immunosuppressive therapy (including steroids > 10 mg prednisone/day or equivalent).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Chronic immunosuppressive therapy requirement is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Receipt of live attenuated vaccine within 30 days.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout for live vaccines is not a simple lab cutoff or allowed typed exclusion.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: 1L NSCLC participants with genetic alteration such as EGFR that has a targeted therapy in 1L as per local SoC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This exclusion relates to available local SoC targeted therapy for genetic alterations and is not a clean standalone typed status check.
